info.title: BG Tutor API
info.description: Local headless backgammon library and GNUbg analysis. No authentication; bind to loopback.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Literal substring, 3–200 characters. Omit only when supplying an exact tag.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Exact normalized tag; can be combined with the text and kind filters.

parameters.name: database_id
parameters.description: Restrict all note scopes to one logical database.

200.description: Native Anki package; review history remains independent

parameters.name: database_id
parameters.description: Target logical database. Omitted: default database.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Resume after this persisted event ID

200.description:
SSE wire format: id: <persisted integer>
event: <queued|running|progress|completed|failed>
data: <JobProgress JSON>

. Each data field conforms to components.schemas.JobProgress. Stream ends after terminal event or service shutdown; reconnect resumes via Last-Event-ID.

parameters.name: game_no
parameters.description: Restrict decisions to one source game.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Continue after a move-analysis row ID, keeping the same filters.

parameters.name: errors_only
parameters.description: Only decisions losing at least 0.04 normalized equity.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: checker or cube; omitted means both.

200.description: Original/SGF file or ZIP for multiple matches

parameters.name: game_no
parameters.description: One-based source game number; omitted means the whole match.

200.description: Latest analysis job for this game or whole-match scope, or null if none has been submitted. Includes persisted partial summary during execution.

parameters.name: game_no
parameters.description: One-based source game number; omitted means the whole match.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Optional literal tag substring, at most 64 characters.

game_no.description: Restrict a match analysis source to this source game.

comment.description: Plaintext Markdown; never interpreted as trusted HTML.

id.description: Null for an existing target without a saved annotation.

version.description: Zero until first save. Supply this value as expected_version when saving.
Expected revision on PUT; a successful write increments it by one.

xg_path.description: Omission preserves a previously configured XG path.

depth.description: Decisions into the game; this is not evaluation ply.

equity_kind.description: Cubeful equity normalized to the current cube (match play uses GNUbg NEMG).

probabilities.description:
Win, win gammon (including backgammon), win backgammon,
loss, lose gammon (including backgammon), lose backgammon.

best.description: Best checker notation or cube action under the native evaluation.

best_equity.description: Best normalized cubeful equity from this player's perspective, in the same units.

checker_no.description:
One-based imported checker position; also links its preceding no-double decision.
Actual double/take/drop decisions have no checker number.

decision_no.description: One-based sequence of all checker and cube decisions within this game.

dice.description: The original imported dice for checker decisions; absent for cube decisions.

equity_loss.description: Nonnegative best-minus-played equity, rounded to GNUbg's six exported decimals.

evaluation_status.description:
"evaluated" or "forced". A forced dance has null equities and zero loss;
missing analysis for any evaluable decision fails the game analysis.

played.description: Actual GNUbg checker notation, or "no double", "double", "take", "drop".

played_equity.description:
Normalized cubeful equity of the actual decision, from this player's perspective.
Cube equities use the cube value before an offer, including for its response.

player.description: Absolute color: 0 is White, 1 is Black.

game_no.description: Source game number for a single-game match analysis; null means the whole match.

JobProgress.description: JSON encoded in the `data:` line of each job SSE message.

kind.description: analysis: five candidate moves; dice: 21 weighted rolls.

plies.description: GNUbg search depth, 0 to 2. Omitted uses saved analysis depth.

position_id.description: Database UUID of the imported position, not its GNUbg ID.

game_no.description: Analyze one source game in its original match context; omitted means the whole match.

plies.description: Native GNUbg checker and cube search depth. Omitted uses saved analysis depth.

oneOf.description:
Native GNUbg normalized loss and non-trivial decision denominator.
Missing for legacy results or if any analyzed game lacks native statistics.

position_uuid.description: Imported board before this checker move; cube-only decisions have no checker board.

games.description: Number of games contributing complete native statistics.

method.description:
gnubg_emg_500_v1: 500 × native normalized loss / (unforced checker + close/actual cube).
GNUbg counting is not interchangeable with XG or BMAB counting.

checker_equity_loss.description: Sum of normalized equity losses, not a performance rating (PR).

value.description: Null if the native denominator is zero; lower values indicate less equity lost.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor; continue with the same filters.

again.description: Seconds until due for each rating; Again and initial Hard use learning steps.

move_no.description: One-based actual source event, including explicit cube actions.

position_uuid.description: Checker notes use this canonical position occurrence; cube notes use id.

file.description: One MAT, SGF, binary XG, or BGBlitz BGF file, at most 16 MiB including multipart envelope.
